# Backend provenance

`ochyai_camera.py` and `../convert_models.py` were adapted from [ochyai/streamdiffusion-mac](https://github.com/ochyai/streamdiffusion-mac), retrieved 2026-10-06. The upstream README declares MIT; no separate license file or copyright notice was present in that source. Attribution, standard license text, and the scope of local changes are recorded in [THIRD_PARTY.md](../../THIRD_PARTY.md).

The sketch integration follows [IDKiro/sdxs/demo_sketch.py](https://github.com/IDKiro/sdxs/blob/main/demo_sketch.py), under Apache 2.0. Downloaded model weights retain their own terms.
